---
title: "Circular native MAG heat tree with aligned quality rings"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: false
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

Figure 1 review only. Add one terminal leaf for each of the 348 MAGs to the
verified 698-node taxonomy. Existing taxonomic clade abundances stay unchanged;
each MAG leaf uses its own equal-sample mean mapped-read fraction. Direct
assignments move from taxonomic nodes to MAG leaves, preventing double counting.
Native metacoder draws the taxonomy and MAG branches with deterministic custom
circular cladogram coordinates. All MAG leaves share one radius. Two aligned
annular tracks display completeness (inner) then contamination (outer).
The installed package is not modified: a local copy of heat_tree resolves only
its layout dispatcher through a private environment. All native sizing, polygons,
labels and abundance legends remain metacoder's.

```sh
PHAGE_UV_METACODER_LIB=/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/.local/share/R/phage-uv-metacoder-0.3.9 \
  bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/mag_heat_tree_circular_quality.qmd NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
python3 tests/test_mag_heat_tree_circular_quality.py NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
```

```{r}
#| label: native-mag-quality-leaves
lib <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_METACODER_LIB")
if(nzchar(lib)) .libPaths(c(lib,.libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(metacoder); library(ggplot2); library(ggnewscale)})
check <- function(ok,msg) if(!isTRUE(ok)) stop(msg,call.=FALSE)
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
check(length(args)==1L,"Supply a new output directory")
output <- normalizePath(args[[1]],mustWork=FALSE)
check(!file.exists(output),"Output exists; use a new version")
repo <- normalizePath(getwd())
data <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT",
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"))
native <- file.path(data,"derived/native_metacoder_heat_trees_2026-09-13-v4")
mag_source <- file.path(data,"derived/mag_global_abundance_tree_2026-09-13-v2")
paths <- c(nodes=file.path(native,"tables/mag_plotted_nodes.tsv"),
  assignments=file.path(mag_source,"tables/deepest_assignments.tsv"),
  quality=file.path(data,"binning/dereplication/data_tables/Widb.csv"),
  family_colours=file.path(data,"derived/taxonomic_resolution_exploration/tables/family_microshades_colour_key.tsv"))
hash <- function(p) substr(system2("shasum",c("-a","256",shQuote(p)),stdout=TRUE)[[1]],1,64)
input_hashes <- vapply(paths,hash,character(1))
for(spec in list(c(native,"tables/mag_plotted_nodes.tsv"),c(mag_source,"tables/deepest_assignments.tsv"))) {
  m <- fread(file.path(spec[[1]],"output_sha256.tsv")); rel <- spec[[2]]
  check(identical(hash(file.path(spec[[1]],rel)),m[path==rel,sha256]),"Verified source changed")
}
taxa <- fread(paths[["nodes"]])
assigned <- fread(paths[["assignments"]])
qc <- fread(paths[["quality"]])
qc[,MAG_ID:=sub("[.]fasta$","",genome)]
check(nrow(qc)==348L && !anyDuplicated(qc$MAG_ID),"Expected 348 unique quality records")
check(nrow(assigned)==348L && !anyDuplicated(assigned$MAG_ID) &&
  setequal(assigned$MAG_ID,qc$MAG_ID),"MAG-quality join mismatch")
check(all(is.finite(qc$completeness)&qc$completeness>=75&qc$completeness<=100),"Completeness outside fixed 75-100% scale")
check(all(is.finite(qc$contamination)&qc$contamination>=0&qc$contamination<=25),"Contamination outside fixed 0-25% scale")
mags <- merge(assigned,qc[,.(MAG_ID,completeness,contamination)],by="MAG_ID",sort=TRUE)
mags[,node_id:=sprintf("mag%03d",seq_len(.N))]
mags[,`:=`(parent=assigned_node,phylum=taxa$phylum[match(assigned_node,taxa$node_id)],
  colour=taxa$colour[match(assigned_node,taxa$node_id)])]
check(!anyNA(mags$colour),"Unknown parent node")
nodes <- taxa[,.(node_id,parent,rank,taxon,phylum,clade_abundance,clade_mags,
  direct_abundance=0,direct_mags=0L,colour,plot_label)]
leaves <- mags[,.(node_id,parent,rank="MAG",taxon=MAG_ID,phylum,
  clade_abundance=mean_abundance,clade_mags=1L,direct_abundance=mean_abundance,
  direct_mags=1L,colour,plot_label="")]
nodes <- rbind(nodes,leaves)
# Use the actual frozen stacked-bar key, not newly generated family shades.
# Higher ranks retain phylum colours. Family and descendant nodes (including
# every MAG leaf) use the bar category, including its explicit remainder bins.
family_key <- fread(paths[["family_colours"]])
check(!anyDuplicated(family_key$display_category),"Duplicate family colour category")
nodes[,`:=`(colour_category=paste0("phylum: ",phylum),family_ancestor=NA_character_)]
for(i in seq_len(nrow(nodes))) {
  if(!nodes$rank[i] %in% c("family","genus","species","MAG")) next
  ancestor <- nodes$node_id[i]
  while(length(ancestor)==1L && !is.na(ancestor) && ancestor %in% nodes$node_id) {
    j <- match(ancestor,nodes$node_id)
    if(nodes$rank[j]=="family") break
    ancestor <- nodes$parent[j]
  }
  family <- if(length(ancestor)==1L && !is.na(ancestor) && ancestor %in% nodes$node_id)
    nodes$taxon[match(ancestor,nodes$node_id)] else NA_character_
  key_row <- which(family_key$category_type=="top25 named" &
    family_key$display_category==family & family_key$phylum==nodes$phylum[i])
  if(!length(key_row)) key_row <- which(family_key$category_type=="within-phylum remainder" &
    family_key$phylum==nodes$phylum[i])
  if(!length(key_row)) key_row <- which(family_key$category_type=="global remainder")
  check(length(key_row)==1L,"Ambiguous family colour lookup")
  nodes[i,`:=`(colour=family_key$colour[key_row],
    colour_category=family_key$display_category[key_row],family_ancestor=family)]
}
mags[,colour:=nodes$colour[match(node_id,nodes$node_id)]]
check(nrow(nodes)==1046L && !anyDuplicated(nodes$node_id),"Expected 1046 unique nodes")
check(abs(sum(nodes$direct_abundance)-1)<1e-12 && sum(nodes$direct_mags)==348L,"Direct assignment conservation failed")
for(i in seq_len(nrow(nodes))) {
  id <- nodes$node_id[[i]]
  check(abs(nodes$clade_abundance[[i]]-nodes$direct_abundance[[i]]-
    sum(nodes[parent==id,clade_abundance]))<1e-12,"Clade conservation failed")
}
# Deterministic depth-first order keeps every clade contiguous around the circle.
children <- split(nodes$node_id,nodes$parent)
root <- nodes[is.na(parent)|!parent %in% node_id,node_id]
check(length(root)==1L,"Expected a single taxonomy root")
descendants <- list(); heights <- setNames(numeric(nrow(nodes)),nodes$node_id)
visit <- function(id) {
  kids <- children[[id]]
  if(!length(kids)) {
    descendants[[id]] <<- id
    return(id)
  }
  kids <- kids[order(nodes$taxon[match(kids,nodes$node_id)],kids)]
  result <- unlist(lapply(kids,visit),use.names=FALSE)
  descendants[[id]] <<- result
  heights[[id]] <<- 1+max(heights[kids])
  result
}
leaf_order <- visit(root)
check(length(leaf_order)==348L && setequal(leaf_order,mags$node_id),"Circular order lost MAGs")
leaf_index <- setNames(seq_along(leaf_order),leaf_order)
angles <- vapply(nodes$node_id,function(id)
  pi/2-2*pi*(mean(leaf_index[descendants[[id]]])-.5)/348,numeric(1))
radial <- 1-heights[nodes$node_id]/heights[[root]]
coordinates <- data.table(node_id=nodes$node_id,angle=angles,radial=radial,
  x=radial*cos(angles),y=radial*sin(angles))
# Version-specific, isolated layout adapter; do not patch the package namespace.
check(as.character(packageVersion("metacoder"))=="0.3.9","Revalidate layout adapter for this metacoder version")
native_heat_tree <- getS3method("heat_tree","default",envir=asNamespace("metacoder"))
layout_env <- new.env(parent=environment(native_heat_tree))
layout_env$layout_functions <- function(name=NULL,graph=NULL,intitial_coords=NULL,...) {
  if(is.null(name)&&is.null(graph)) return(c(metacoder:::layout_functions(),"circular-mag"))
  if(identical(name,"circular-mag")) {
    ids <- igraph::V(graph)$name
    xy <- as.matrix(coordinates[match(ids,node_id),.(x,y)])
    check(!anyNA(xy),"Missing circular coordinates")
    return(xy)
  }
  metacoder:::layout_functions(name,graph,intitial_coords,...)
}
environment(native_heat_tree) <- layout_env

set.seed(913)
grDevices::pdf(NULL,width=14,height=12)
p <- native_heat_tree(taxon_id=nodes$node_id,supertaxon_id=nodes$parent,
  node_label=nodes$plot_label,node_size=100*nodes$clade_abundance,edge_size=100*nodes$clade_abundance,
  node_color=nodes$colour,edge_color=nodes$colour,
  node_size_trans="area",edge_size_trans="area",node_size_interval=c(0,100),edge_size_interval=c(0,100),
  node_size_range=c(0,.045),edge_size_range=c(0,.018),
  node_label_size=1,node_label_size_range=c(.013,.013),node_label_color="#252525",
  node_label_max=1000,repel_labels=TRUE,repel_force=2,repel_iter=3000,
  layout="circular-mag",initial_layout=NULL,
  make_node_legend=TRUE,make_edge_legend=FALSE,node_legend_title=NA,
  node_size_axis_label="Mean relative abundance (%)",node_color_axis_label=NA,
  title=NULL,background_color="#FFFFFF",margin_size=c(.06,.06,.06,.06),verbose=TRUE)
grDevices::dev.off()
# Move the native abundance key clear of the outer ring, without resizing it.
for(i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
  d <- p$layers[[i]]$data
  if(!is.data.frame(d)||!"group" %in% names(d)) next
  is_key <- grepl("legend",d$group)
  for(k in intersect(c("x","xmin","xmax"),names(d))) d[is_key,k] <- d[is_key,k]+.14
  p$layers[[i]]$data <- d
}
geometry <- as.data.table(p$layers[[1]]$data)
# Native circles are closed regular 35-gons: bounding-box midpoints are biased.
# The centroid of the 35 distinct vertices recovers the exact layout centre.
centres <- geometry[grepl("_node$",group),.(x=mean(x[-.N]),y=mean(y[-.N]),
  radius=max(x)-mean(x[-.N])),by=group]
centres[,node_id:=sub("_node$","",group)]
check(setequal(centres$node_id,nodes$node_id),"Renderer lost nodes")
mags <- merge(mags,centres[,.(node_id,x,y,radius)],by="node_id",sort=FALSE)
# Native rescaling is isotropic; recover the circle centre from its root.
origin <- centres[node_id==root]
mags[,`:=`(leaf_order=unname(leaf_index[node_id]),
  angle=coordinates$angle[match(node_id,coordinates$node_id)])]
mags[,leaf_radius:=sqrt((x-origin$x)^2+(y-origin$y)^2)]
check(diff(range(mags$leaf_radius))<1e-8,"MAG leaves are not on a common circle")
tip_radius <- mean(mags$leaf_radius)
mags[,`:=`(origin_x=origin$x,origin_y=origin$y)]
setorder(mags,leaf_order)
ring_start <- tip_radius+max(mags$radius)+.012
ring_width <- .022
ring_gap <- .005
pairs <- list(); polygons <- list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(mags))) {
  m <- mags[i]
  for(j in 1:2) {
    metric <- c("completeness","contamination")[[j]]
    inner <- ring_start+(j-1)*(ring_width+ring_gap)
    outer <- inner+ring_width
    # Small visual separation, identical angular sector for both measurements.
    half_angle <- pi/348*.94
    theta <- seq(m$angle-half_angle,m$angle+half_angle,length.out=5)
    radii <- c(rep(inner,5),rep(outer,5))
    arc <- c(theta,rev(theta))
    pairs[[length(pairs)+1L]] <- data.table(node_id=m$node_id,MAG_ID=m$MAG_ID,
      metric=metric,value=m[[metric]],leaf_order=m$leaf_order,angle=m$angle,
      inner_radius=inner,outer_radius=outer,leaf_x=m$x,leaf_y=m$y,
      cx=origin$x+mean(c(inner,outer))*cos(m$angle),
      cy=origin$y+mean(c(inner,outer))*sin(m$angle))
    polygons[[length(polygons)+1L]] <- data.table(node_id=m$node_id,MAG_ID=m$MAG_ID,
      metric=metric,value=m[[metric]],corner=seq_along(arc),
      x=origin$x+radii*cos(arc),y=origin$y+radii*sin(arc))
  }
}
tiles <- rbindlist(pairs); polygons <- rbindlist(polygons)
label_layer <- which(vapply(p$layers,function(x)inherits(x$geom,"GeomFitText"),logical(1)))
native_labels <- p$layers[[label_layer]]
halo <- lapply(seq(0,2*pi,length.out=9)[-9],function(angle) {
  shifted <- native_labels$data
  shifted$xmin <- shifted$xmin+.0008*cos(angle); shifted$xmax <- shifted$xmax+.0008*cos(angle)
  shifted$ymin <- shifted$ymin+.0008*sin(angle); shifted$ymax <- shifted$ymax+.0008*sin(angle)
  do.call(ggfittext::geom_fit_text,c(list(data=shifted,mapping=native_labels$mapping,
    inherit.aes=FALSE,colour="white"),native_labels$geom_params))
})
p$layers <- c(p$layers[-label_layer],halo,list(native_labels))
p <- p+
  geom_segment(data=tiles[metric=="completeness"],aes(x=leaf_x,y=leaf_y,xend=cx,yend=cy),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,colour="#BBBBBB",linewidth=.12)+
  geom_polygon(data=polygons[metric=="completeness"],aes(x=x,y=y,group=node_id,fill=value),inherit.aes=FALSE,colour=NA)+
  scale_fill_gradient(low="#F7FBFF",high="#08519C",limits=c(75,100),name="1  Completeness (%)",
    guide=guide_colourbar(order=1,direction="horizontal",barwidth=grid::unit(40,"mm"),barheight=grid::unit(3,"mm")))+
  guides(fill=guide_colourbar(order=1,direction="horizontal",title.position="top",
    barwidth=grid::unit(40,"mm"),barheight=grid::unit(3,"mm")))+
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+
  geom_polygon(data=polygons[metric=="contamination"],aes(x=x,y=y,group=node_id,fill=value),inherit.aes=FALSE,colour=NA)+
  scale_fill_gradient(low="#FFF5F0",high="#A50F15",limits=c(0,25),name="2  Contamination (%)",
    guide=guide_colourbar(order=2,direction="horizontal",barwidth=grid::unit(40,"mm"),barheight=grid::unit(3,"mm")))+
  guides(fill=guide_colourbar(order=2,direction="horizontal",title.position="top",
    barwidth=grid::unit(40,"mm"),barheight=grid::unit(3,"mm")))+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",legend.box="horizontal",legend.title=element_text(size=10),legend.text=element_text(size=9))
old_limits <- p$coordinates$limits
# The installed ggnewscale leaves explicit guide availability at "fill";
# update it to the renamed completeness aesthetic for ggplot2 4.x.
p$guides$guides[["fill_ggnewscale_1"]]$available_aes <- "fill_ggnewscale_1"
# Native fixed position scales otherwise censor the new ring at the old limits.
for(axis in c("x","y")) {
  position_scale <- p$scales$get_scales(axis)
  position_scale$limits <- NULL
}
p <- p+coord_equal(xlim=range(c(old_limits$x+.14,polygons$x))+c(-.025,.025),
  ylim=range(c(old_limits$y,polygons$y))+c(-.025,.025),clip="off")
dir.create(file.path(output,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(output,"tables")); dir.create(file.path(output,"source"))
fwrite(coordinates,file.path(output,"tables/circular_layout.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(nodes,file.path(output,"tables/tree_nodes.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(nodes[,.(node_id,rank,taxon,phylum,family_ancestor,colour_category,colour)],
  file.path(output,"tables/node_colour_audit.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(mags,file.path(output,"tables/mag_leaves.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(tiles,file.path(output,"tables/quality_tiles.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(polygons,file.path(output,"tables/quality_tile_polygons.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(geometry,file.path(output,"tables/native_tree_polygons.tsv"),sep="\t")
saveRDS(p,file.path(output,"source/native_mag_quality_tree.rds"))
ggsave(file.path(output,"figures/mag_heat_tree_circular_quality.pdf"),p,
  device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE,width=14,height=12,units="in")
check(identical(input_hashes,vapply(paths,hash,character(1))),"Input changed during execution")
for(kind in names(paths)) file.copy(paths[[kind]],file.path(output,"source",basename(paths[[kind]])))
file.copy(file.path(repo,"analysis/mag_heat_tree_circular_quality.qmd"),file.path(output,"source/mag_heat_tree_circular_quality.qmd"))
fwrite(data.table(input=names(paths),path=unname(paths),sha256=input_hashes),file.path(output,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("Author-review candidate; manuscript and viral figure unchanged.",
  "Colours harmonised with frozen family stacked bars: family nodes and descendants use exact named-family or remainder-category colours; higher ranks retain phylum colours. No topology, abundance or quality change.",
  "Native metacoder tree: 698 taxonomic nodes + 348 individual MAG leaves. Clade areas and MAG proportions use the verified 12-sample equal-weight means.",
  "Circular cladogram: all 348 MAG leaves share one radius; completeness is the inner ring, contamination the outer ring. Each MAG occupies the same angle in both rings. Custom deterministic layout adapter; native metacoder geometry and sizes.",
  "Completeness 75-100% (blue); contamination 0-25% (red): same scales as the earlier MAG annotation rings. No clipping, filtering, or taxon-level averaging of MAG quality.",
  "Only quality annotations added. No expression annotations or MAG-name labels; exact MAG-to-leaf correspondence is in tables/mag_leaves.tsv.",
  "Direct assignments transferred to terminal MAG leaves; parent clade abundances remain inclusive and must not be added to descendant values.",
  "Topology denotes taxonomy, not sequence divergence. This is MAG-mapped read composition, not whole-community or absolute abundance.",
  capture.output(sessionInfo())),file.path(output,"REVIEW_README.txt"))
files <- list.files(output,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(output)+2L),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),file.path(output,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
cat(nrow(nodes),"nodes;",nrow(mags),"MAG leaves;",nrow(tiles),"quality tiles;",diff(range(mags$leaf_radius)),"leaf radius spread\n")
```
